name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
short_description: High-interest small savings scheme (current 8.2% p.a.) with tax exemption for girl children up to 10 years of age.
detailed_description: Under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, parents or legal guardians can open an SSY account for a girl child from her birth until she turns 10 years old. Deposits can be made for 15 years, maturing after 21 years with triple tax exemption (EEE).
description_kannada: ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಮದುವೆ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಪೋಷಕರು 10 ವರ್ಷದೊಳಗಿನ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಗುವಿನ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಚೆ ಕಚೇರಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ದರದ ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಖಾತೆ ತೆರೆಯುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Must be Girl Child
rules.clarification_question_en: Is the child for whom the account is being opened a girl?

rules.name: Age must be 10 years or below
rules.description_kannada: ಮಗುವಿನ ವಯಸ್ಸು 10 ವರ್ಷ ಅಥವಾ ಅದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಿರಬೇಕು
rules.clarification_question_en: What is the age of the girl child?

benefits_summary: 8.2% annual compounded interest, complete tax exemption under Sec 80C, partial withdrawal for higher education at age 18.
required_documents: Aadhaar / ID proof of parent or guardian
application_process: Visit any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Submit the SSY account opening form with the child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC.
source_title: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Govt of India
source_excerpt: The account may be opened by one of the guardian in the name of a girl child, who has not attained the age of ten years as on the date of opening of the account.
